name: Faith Delaney
bio: Faith Delaney is a British actress. She started 2025 filming a lead role in The Death of Robin Hood with Hugh Jackman and Jodie Comer. In 2024 she made her cinematic debut playing the daughter of Tom Hanks & Robin Wright in the movie HERE, directed by the legendary Robert Zemeckis.

credits.title: The Legend of Zelda
credits.overview: A live-action adaptation of Nintendo's Legend of Zelda video game series.

credits.title: The Death of Robin Hood
credits.overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

credits.title: Hamnet
credits.overview: The powerful story of love and loss that inspired the creation of Shakespeare's timeless masterpiece, Hamlet.

credits.title: Wicked: For Good
credits.overview: As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, Glinda and Elphaba must unite one last time with honesty and empathy to fulfill their shared destiny and change the fate of Oz forever.

credits.title: American Sweatshop
credits.overview: A content moderator is tasked with purging offensive media from the internet. When she witnesses a crime in a video, she is lured away from the safety of her keyboard as she obsessively seeks to hold someone accountable.

credits.title: Behind the Curtain: Stranger Things: The First Shadow
credits.overview: Go behind the scenes with the cast and crew of “Stranger Things: The First Shadow”, the award-winning live stage show that expands the Hawkins universe.

credits.title: Here
credits.overview: An odyssey through time and memory, centered on a place in New Jersey where—from wilderness, and then, later, from a home—love, loss, struggle, hope and legacy play out between couples and families over generations.

credits.title: Christmas on Mistletoe Farm
credits.overview: After inheriting a farm at Christmas time, a widowed father makes a bumpy adjustment to village life — while his kids hatch a plan to stay there forever.
